thread:
liam.sre: Quick note — eu-central streaming probe started spiking 5xxs around 03:10 UTC.
maria.ops: saw it too, graphs look like scrape timeouts followed by 502s from the sidecar
devon: suspecting SNAT port exhaustion on the probe side; seen similar when probe RPS was 300/s
maria.ops: can we reduce probe concurrency or move a subset to a different NAT gateway?
liam.sre: yes — moving some probes to the standby nat-gateway lowered failure rate on my test
devon: also worth checking prometheus scrape_interval for the probe exporter. we're scraping every 10s rn which makes a lot of short-lived connections
anya: +1 on scrape interval; cost vs fidelity tradeoff. suggest 30s for embeddings probes, 15s for streaming handshake checks
probe-bot: alert: blackbox_probe_eu_central_5xx_rate > 1% for 5m
maria.ops: that alert flapped earlier; current alert config has no suppression window, maybe add for probe noise
liam.sre: proposal: add a rolling median filter in alert rule, and introduce a label join to ignore probes with recent deployment tag
liam.sre: example rule:
```
- alert: BlackboxProbeHighErrorRate
  expr: increase(blackbox_probe_http_status{job="blackbox"}[5m]) / increase(blackbox_probe_requests_total{job="blackbox"}[5m]) > 0.01
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Blackbox probe error rate >1% ({{ $labels.region }})"
```
devon: also add `record: probe:http_5xx_ratio` with `histogram_quantile(0.5,... )` to reduce single-probe noise
anya: runbook note: if eu-central probe errors + upstream 503s + snat metrics show ports_used > 90% -> rotate probes to alt-eni and reduce scrape concurrency
maria.ops: small config we rolled out earlier:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_probe]
    action: keep
  - source_labels: [__address__]
    regex: (.*):9(\d{2})
    replacement: ${1}:9${2}
```
liam.sre: cost side: embedding probes (longer requests) are the expensive ones — we should sample 1% of users for full embedding SLOs, rest get a lightweight fingerprint check
anya: agreed. Sampling reduces GPU load and egress costs
devon: action items: 1) set embeddings scrape to 30s and sample rate to 1% (maria), 2) add 10m for alert `for`, add median smoothing (liam), 3) schedule NAT rotation script during low-traffic window (devon)
maria.ops: I'll open a PR for relabel + scrape change, estimate 20m work
liam.sre: can you also add a Grafana panel for snat_port_utilization and probe_conn_rate on the streaming dashboard? small heatmap would help
maria.ops: will do. tagging this thread in the runbook: /link runbook#probe-snats
anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
probe-bot: note: deploy-bot started rollout blackbox-exporter v2.3.1 to eu-central at 03:05 UTC
maria.ops: that's probably the noisy deploy, adding post-deploy flapping suppression to alerting will help
liam.sre: closing loop — if errors persist after config change, escalate to network infra and we'll throttle probe RPS
